summary: The hawkish Fed under Chair Kevin Warsh — which signaled growing support for rate hikes, with markets now pricing an 80% chance of a December increase — continues to crush gold and crypto while pushing bonds higher on flight-to-safety flows. Progress in US-Iran peace negotiations has drained gold's geopolitical premium, with oil retreating to pre-conflict levels and safe-haven demand fading just as rate-hike risk rises.
tweet: Hawkish Fed rate-hike odds and a fading US-Iran war premium are hammering gold and crypto while bonds catch a bid.
